App concept
  1. Thursday evening

    Imagine Your name in her pocket.

    Princess Day is this weekend. She wants the full look, without leaving home. Here's how she finds you.

    Stays on this device. It just makes the story yours.

    Scroll to follow her

  2. Open

    She opens PinkOut.

    Beauty at home, sorted by what she needs tonight: makeup, hair, nails, lashes, henna and skincare.

  3. Discover

    Your name, where she is looking.

    Artists near her, free this weekend, with their work right there to compare.

  4. Your profile

    She sees your work.

    Your services, your portfolio, your Instagram: everything she needs to choose you.

  5. Booked

    One tap, and it's booked.

    Saturday, 18:30, at her home. The booking comes to you; she gets her evening back.

  6. After

    The look, credited to Your name.

    She shares the photo, the look carries your name, and next time she books again.

FAQ

Good questions, clear answers.

What exactly is PinkOut?

A women-first lifestyle, creativity and entertainment destination coming soon to Riyadh, with seven experience zones and an app in development.

When and where does it open?

In Riyadh. The exact date and venue will be announced once confirmed.

What are the fees or commission?

Commercial terms are shared after you apply, in the deck for your partner type.

Are any partners confirmed?

No partnerships have been announced yet.

Do I need a license to apply?

Yes: a valid license or professional certificate, plus a portfolio or Instagram that shows your work.

When do bookings start?

When the PinkOut app launches. Beauty services are booked through the app, at home.

Can I work at the event?

The event is run with event partners. Beauty service partners work through the PinkOut app, with clients at home.

Can salons apply, or only freelancers?

Both. The form asks whether you're applying as a freelance artist or as a salon or beauty business.
